d: Von Neumann replicant probe destinations in Dennis E. Taylor’s Bobiverse series.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: First interstellar target reached by Bob-1 (HEAVEN-1), where he defeats the Brazilian probe and builds Riker, Bill, Milo, and Mario.

gaia-5164120762333028736.x: System where Original Bob discovers and shepherds the primitive Deltan species on planet Eden.

gaia-4847957292277399296.x: Nearby G8V star system colonised by human survivors evacuated from Earth by the Bobiverse.

gaia-425040000962559616.x: Artificial megastructure (Topopolis) orbiting Eta Cassiopeiae housing the Quinlan civilisation in Heaven's River.

b.s: Hard science-fiction series following Bob Johansson and his Von Neumann replicant descendants exploring Epsilon Eridani, Delta Eridani, 82 Eridani, and Eta Cassiopeiae.
b.r: We Are Legion (We Are Bob) (2016) – Heaven’s River (2020)
